g.text: One shared gateway key lets the Research agent refund the hotel payment, and the log names the account owner.
Believe there is one administrator, and:
· one login in every config, set up once
· the log names the login, not the service
· the DBA can only revoke it for everyone
A service makes only the calls its code makes.
Fix: each owner issues each component its own scoped,
short-lived credential; logs name the component.
(1) the runtime signs with the account owner's key
(2) every agent reaches every gateway tool
(3) the Research agent's model refunds because it can
Fix: one identity per agent, and a key per call from the
